mapper.insert: insert into tbl_place (google_place_id, kakao_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_lat, place_lng) values (#{googlePlaceId}, #{kakaoPlaceId}, #{placeName}, #{placeAddress}, #{placeLat}, #{placeLng})
mapper.select: select id, google_place_id, kakao_place_id, place_name, place_address, place_lat, place_lng, created_datetime, updated_datetime from tbl_place where id = #{id}
